title: Edge Parity
scramble: 3Rw U2 3Rw x U2 3Rw U2 4Rw' U2 3Lw U2 3Rw' U2 3Rw U2 3Rw' U2 3Rw'
notes: Single edge appears flipped during edge pairing - occurs in 50% of 7×7 solves
story: The 7×7 shares the same edge parity characteristic as the 5×5. Because of the fixed center, you'll only encounter edge parity during pairing, never OLL or PLL parity.
description: The only parity case on 7×7. Similar to 5×5 but uses 3-layer and 4-layer wide moves. No OLL or PLL parity on odd cubes.
